latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: take a screenshot on macOS and send it to Telegram via the Telegram Bot API.
- Designed to work around the OpenClaw message tool bug (#15541) that fails to send media.
- Requires Telegram bot token, target chat ID, and OpenClaw profile name as setup/prerequisites.
- Handles screenshot capture, workspace file management, and direct API upload.
- Supports any OpenClaw profile by specifying the profile name in use.
